mapper.select: SELECT * FROM department enabled=true ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.*,u.display_name name,dep.name department_name FROM doctor d JOIN app_user u ON u.id=d.user_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id d.enabled=true AND dep.enabled=true AND u.enabled=true AND d.department_id=#{departmentId} AND (u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR d.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT *,stock-reserved available FROM drug enabled=true AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND stock-reserved<=threshold ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id,username,display_name,role,enabled,created_at FROM app_user role=#{role} AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.*,u.display_name actor_name FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=l.actor_id l.operation LIKE CONCAT('%',#{operation},'%') AND l.actor_id=#{actorId} AND l.created_at>=#{from} AND l.created_at<DATE_ADD(#{to},INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND l.success=#{success} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.*,d.name drug_name,u.display_name actor_name FROM stock_movement m JOIN drug d ON d.id=m.drug_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=m.actor_id m.drug_id=#{drugId} ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
